title: Service account token auto-mounted via automountServiceAccountToken: true (k8s) — review required
description: The Kubernetes setting automountServiceAccountToken: true mounts a service account token into every pod that uses the account. Any process in the container, including injected code, can then call the API server with that identity. Disable the mount unless the pod calls the API, and use a projected token with a short audience (a projected token with a restricted audience). This lexical rule flags the setting.
remediation: Set automountServiceAccountToken: true to false, or mount a projected token with a restricted audience and short expiry (a projected token with a restricted audience).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the explicit true; an absent field inherits the namespace default and is not flagged.
